title: Baby Girl Playing in Playpen, 1960 Pleasant Lake B&W Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot depicting a baby girl named Nevette lounging inside a playpen placed outdoors on Independence Day, July 4, 1960, at Pleasant Lake. The infant reaches up with her right arm while resting on a white blanket set inside a wooden-slat enclosure. The photo features scalloped deckled edges characteristic of mid-century snapshot prints.
